text: The Minister detects garlic. Ketu calls it an aromatic diplomatic misunderstanding; Capital calls it an incident. The host delegation asks for seconds.
The Minister praises the impeccably compliant 'Food (hot)'. The host delegation quietly asks where the flavour went.
The gold-lettered menu is admired by both delegations. 'Fish soup with ambition' becomes the visit’s unlikely diplomatic triumph.
The Minister notices 'diplomatique' on the menu. Ketu insists it is a typo; the host delegation decides it is a joke.
At the Minister's reception, the independent caterer provides a straightforward invoice. Capital notes the transparent procurement; the protocol official's cousin does not attend.
A correspondent reveals the caterer's family connection during the reception. Capital asks who approved the contract; the cousin compliments your discretion.
The renegotiated contract survives a question at the Minister's reception. Capital is relieved that the invoice now includes sitting on the chairs.
The caterer's family connection becomes the reception's most popular rumour. Capital discovers that the bargain required a remarkably expensive sequel.
At the Minister's visit, the Deputy Minister finds a prominent seat. The fern is reassigned to a position of quiet influence.
The original seating plan survives. The Deputy Minister delivers remarks from behind the fern, which receives several diplomatic introductions.
